comments.value: I think at this point VRChat should either give an option to disable AVPro, or disable it when linux is used.

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}: At some point it *was* disabled by default, and there was a launch option to enable it.

Then VRChat devs in their infinite wisdom decided to just enable it by default **without a way to disable it again** >.>

I've managed to trace the issue to the point where `AVProVideo.dll` loads:

```

2023.08.22 13:39:52 Warning    -  Only custom filters can be played. Please add a custom filter or an audioclip to the audiosource (World_Music).

2023.08.22 13:39:52 Log        -  [Always] UdonManager.OnSceneLoaded took '0.297'

2023.08.22 13:39:53 Log        -  [Behaviour] Skipping registration of a video player on 'Udon (VideoCore)' with the VideoPlayerOverseer as automatic resync is disabled.

2023.08.22 13:39:53 Log        -  [Behaviour] Skipping registration of a video player on 'Udon (VideoCore)' with the VideoPlayerOverseer as automatic resync is disabled.

>>>>>> Game freezes here

```

For comparison these are the logs if I block `AVProVideo.dll` from loading (via file permissions):

```

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Warning    -  Only custom filters can be played. Please add a custom filter or an audioclip to the audiosource (World_Music).

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Log        -  [Always] UdonManager.OnSceneLoaded took '0.301'

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Log        -  [Behaviour] Skipping registration of a video player on 'Udon (VideoCore)' with the VideoPlayerOverseer as automatic resync is disabled.

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Log        -  [Behaviour] Skipping registration of a video player on 'Udon (VideoCore)' with the VideoPlayerOverseer as automatic resync is disabled.

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Error      -  Failed to load 'Z:/media/Media2/Downloads/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/VRChat/VRChat_Data/Plugins\x86_64/AVProVideo.dll', expected x64 architecture, but was Unknown architecture.

 You must recompile your plugin for x64 architecture.

RenderHeads.Media.AVProVideo.WindowsMediaPlayer:InitialisePlatform()

RenderHeads.Media.AVProVideo.MediaPlayer:CreateMediaPlayer()

RenderHeads.Media.AVProVideo.MediaPlayer:Initialise()

RenderHeads.Media.AVProVideo.MediaPlayer:Start()

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Error      -  [AVProVideo] Failed to load DLL. Unable to load DLL 'AVProVideo': The specified module could not be found.

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Error      -  [AVProVideo] Not supported on this platform WindowsPlayer X570 GAMING X (Gigabyte Technology Co., Ltd.) AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor Windows 10  (10.0.19043) 64bit.  Using 

null media player!

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Log        -  [AVProVideo] Initialising AVPro Video v2.5.6 (native plugin v0.0.0) on AMD RADV NAVI10/Direct3D 11.0 [level 11.1] (MT False) on WindowsPlayer

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Error      -  [AVProVideo] No MediaReference specified

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Error      -  [AVProVideo] No file path specified

2023.08.22 13:17:31 Log        -  Loaded asset bundle: Thad Magic Mirrors

```

Blocking `AVProVideo.dll` is not a solution since game will freeze anyway later on in the process.

details:
1. Open VRChat on Linux+Proton

2. Join a World with AVPro video player

3. Game freeezes forever during "Initializing World"
title: AVPro video players causes VRChat to freeze during "Initializing World" stage
